verses.he: חָ֭כְמוֹת בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ חָצְבָ֖ה עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ שִׁבְעָֽה׃
verses.en: Wisdom hath builded her house, She hath hewn out her seven pillars;

verses.he: טָבְחָ֣ה טִ֭בְחָהּ מָסְכָ֣ה יֵינָ֑הּ אַ֝֗ף עָֽרְכָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנָֽהּ׃
verses.en: She hath prepared her meat, she hath mingled her wine; She hath also furnished her table.

verses.he: שָֽׁלְחָ֣ה נַעֲרֹתֶ֣יהָ תִקְרָ֑א עַל־גַּ֝פֵּ֗י מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃
verses.en: She hath sent forth her maidens, she calleth, Upon the highest places of the city:

verses.he: מִי־פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה חֲסַר־לֵ֝֗ב אָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: ’Whoso is thoughtless, let him turn in hither’; As for him that lacketh understanding, she saith to him:

verses.he: לְ֭כוּ לַחֲמ֣וּ בְֽלַחֲמִ֑י וּ֝שְׁת֗וּ בְּיַ֣יִן מָסָֽכְתִּי׃
verses.en: ’Come, eat of my bread, And drink of the wine which I have mingled.

verses.he: עִזְב֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם וִֽחְי֑וּ וְ֝אִשְׁר֗וּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ בִּינָֽה׃
verses.en: Forsake all thoughtlessness, and live; And walk in the way of understanding.

verses.he: יֹ֤סֵ֨ר׀ לֵ֗ץ לֹקֵ֣חַֽ ל֣וֹ קָל֑וֹן וּמוֹכִ֖יחַ לְרָשָׁ֣ע מוּמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He that correcteth a scorner getteth to himself shame, And he that reproveth a wicked man, it becometh unto him a blot.

verses.he: אַל־תּ֣וֹכַח לֵ֭ץ פֶּן־יִשְׂנָאֶ֑ךָּ הוֹכַ֥ח לְ֝חָכָ֗ם וְיֶאֱהָבֶֽךָּ׃
verses.en: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee; Reprove a wise man, and he will love thee.

verses.he: תֵּ֣ן לְ֭חָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם־ע֑וֹד הוֹדַ֥ע לְ֝צַדִּ֗יק וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.en: Give to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser; Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.

verses.he: תְּחִלַּ֣ת חָ֭כְמָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים בִּינָֽה׃
verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, And the knowledge of the All-holy is understanding.

verses.he: כִּי־בִ֭י יִרְבּ֣וּ יָמֶ֑יךָ וְיוֹסִ֥יפוּ לְּ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.en: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, And the years of thy life shall be increased.
If thou art wise, thou art wise for thyself; And if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.’

verses.he: אֵ֣שֶׁת כְּ֭סִילוּת הֹֽמִיָּ֑ה פְּ֝תַיּ֗וּת וּבַל־יָ֥דְעָה מָּֽה׃
verses.en: The woman Folly is riotous; She is thoughtless, and knoweth nothing.

verses.he: וְֽ֭יָשְׁבָה לְפֶ֣תַח בֵּיתָ֑הּ עַל־כִּ֝סֵּ֗א מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃
verses.en: And she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,
To call to them that pass by, Who go right on their ways:

verses.he: מִי־פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה וַחֲסַר־לֵ֝֗ב וְאָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: ’Whoso is thoughtless, let him turn in hither’; And as for him that lacketh understanding, she saith to him:
’Stolen waters are sweet, And bread eaten in secret is pleasant.’

verses.he: וְֽלֹא־יָ֭דַע כִּֽי־רְפָאִ֣ים שָׁ֑ם בְּעִמְקֵ֖י שְׁא֣וֹל קְרֻאֶֽיהָ׃
verses.en: But he knoweth not that the shades are there; That her guests are in the depths of the nether-world.
